title: JULIENT shatters chains of heartache in electrifying new single “Break Free”
htmlContent: JULIENT's latest song, "Break Free," featuring Inflection, is about escaping a toxic relationship. It captures the deep feelings of being trapped in a love that lacks kindness, expressing the strong desire for freedom while still feeling tied down. "Break Free" draws listeners in with its captivating sound, combining dark tones with an energetic beat that reflects the pain of heartbreak. JULIENT's vocals shine through, conveying sadness and strength as they express the struggle of feeling ignored and unseen. The music builds in intensity, mirroring the push and pull of a relationship that has lost its warmth. The lyrics speak to the tiredness of giving everything without getting anything back and the challenge of holding onto hope when it feels out of reach. https://open.spotify.com/track/08J5YBgTZB7VXagyKFqwjf It connects with anyone stuck in an emotional cycle they couldn't escape. Whilst listening, you may feel a sense of release, akin to letting out a breath held for too long. "Break Free" brings clarity, a statement of self worth, and a source of inspiration for those who need the courage to move on. Follow on: Instagram
